data.exact_reserve_text: As at 31 December 2021, Syndicate 1110 is declaring a loss of GBP 46.3m (2020: profit of GBP 5.9m) of which GBP 3.4m is attributable to 2020 year of account, GBP 41.8m to 2019 and GBP 1.1m to 2017 & prior years of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder (complex coverage/liability/quantum issues)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development related to a cluster of complex claims arising from one original insured, materially increasing reserves for the 2019 year of account (and affecting 2020 and 2017 & prior to a lesser extent).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 206.422m. During 2021 the syndicate recorded adverse prior-year development totalling GBP 46.3m (strengthening), driven predominantly by a material accumulation of complex claims arising from a single original insured that primarily affected the 2019 year of account (with items attributable to 2020 and 2017 & prior). The adverse movement is concentrated in reinsurance accepted (treaty) business and produced a GBP 42.6m deficit on reinsurance accepted business and a smaller GBP 2.2m deficit on direct business.
raw_causal_phrases: material uncertainty arising from a potential accumulation of claims in respect of a single policyholder.
The claims in question are very complex, due to uncertainty over coverage, liability and the quantum of the claims.

A large material outstanding claims technical provision has been established for potential claims and expenses related to this matter but depending upon the legal outcome of these various factors this reserve may be significantly higher or lower than the outstanding claims provision established.

Within the calendar year net technical result, deficit of GBP 2.2m on direct business (2020: surplus of GBP 1.0m) and deficit of GBP 42.6m on reinsurance accepted business (2020: surplus of GBP 2.5m) relate to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the year-of-account result breakdown in the Managing Agent's report (explicit attribution of the 2021 loss to 2020, 2019 and 2017 & prior years). No separate 'movement in prior year's provision' gross-only reconciliation table was provided; the report also contains a gross claims development triangle which is available. Reinsurance-to-close and other assumptions (RITC, ADC) are present in the business and may distort development patterns. Reinsurance acceptances are presented as negative gross amounts in the segmental table; the consolidated 'Reinsurance acceptances' line is the sum of those rows and therefore negative.
